workplace_task.fil: Sa loob ng 2–4 linggo, ipasuri ang isang mungkahing pagpapabuti sa supervisor gamit ang job aid.
workplace_task.en: Within 2–4 weeks, review one improvement proposal with the supervisor using the job aid.

supervision.fil: Gamitin ang parehong indicator; obserbahan, magbigay ng feedback at umulit.
supervision.en: Use the same indicator; observe, give feedback and retry.

delivery: content specification only; no reminders scheduled

check.prompt_fil: Tapos na ang mapa ng pagsasanay. Ano ang ligtas na susunod na hakbang?
check.prompt_en: The practice map is done. What is the safe next step?

options.fil: Sabihing bukas ang paaralan kahit hindi pa nasuri ng sinuman.
options.en: Say the school is open without checking with anyone.

options.fil: Ipasuri sa DRRM office at health team ang mapa bago gamitin.
options.en: Ask the DRRM office and health team to verify the map before use.

options.fil: Ipaskil ang mapa ng pagsasanay bilang opisyal na evacuation order ng barangay.
options.en: Post the practice map as the barangay's official evacuation order.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Maaaring makapinsala o maantala ang tulong: hindi pa kumpirmado ang paaralan. 2: Beripikadong mapa lang ang dapat gumabay sa tao; itala kung sino at kailan nagpatunay. 3: Hindi opisyal na hazard map o evacuation order ang mapa ng pagsasanay.
check.feedback_en: 1: This may harm or delay help: the school is still not confirmed. 2: Only a verified map should guide people; record who verified it and when. 3: The practice map is not an official hazard map or evacuation order.

check.prompt_fil: Bahagi pa lang ng advisory ang kumpirmado. Ano ang sasabihin mo sa pamilya ni Nena?
check.prompt_en: Only part of the advisory is confirmed. What do you tell Nena's family?

options.fil: Ituring na kasalukuyan ang lumang directory at ibigay ang mga numero nito.
options.en: Treat the old directory as current and give them its numbers.

options.fil: Sabihin ang kumpirmado, ang source at oras nito, at ang hinihintay pa.
options.en: Say what is confirmed, its source and time, and what is pending.

options.fil: Magpahayag ng sariling evacuation order para maaga silang umalis.
options.en: Announce an evacuation order yourself so that they leave early.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Maaaring mali ang lumang impormasyon, at maaaring maantala nito ang tulong. 2: Ipaabot lamang ang beripikadong mensahe, kasama ang oras at source. 3: Huwag gumawa ng sariling evacuation order; sundin ang lokal na awtoridad.
check.feedback_en: 1: Old information may be wrong, and wrong information can delay help. 2: Relay only the verified message, with its time and source. 3: Do not invent an evacuation order; follow the local authority.

check.prompt_fil: Nakapili na ng gamit ang pamilya. Ano ang ligtas na susunod na hakbang?
check.prompt_en: The family has chosen items. What is the safe next step?

options.fil: Kopyahin ang listahan nang hindi isinasaalang-alang ang sanggol o regular na gamot.
options.en: Copy a list without considering the infant or regular medicine.

options.fil: Lagyan ng petsa ang susunod na check at itanong ang access sa gamot.
options.en: Date the next check and ask about access to regular medicine.

options.fil: Ihanda ang bag nang isang beses at huwag na itong suriin muli.
options.en: Pack the bag once and never check it again after that.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Maaaring makapinsala o maantala ang tulong: hindi saklaw ng kinopyang listahan ang kailangan ng pamilyang ito. 2: Pinananatiling handa ng petsa ng check ang bag, at nagbubukas ng tulong ang tanong. 3: Nag-e-expire ang gamit at nagbabago ang pangangailangan; kailangan ng petsa ng pag-check.
check.feedback_en: 1: This may harm or delay help: a copied list misses what this family needs. 2: A dated recheck keeps the bag current, and the question opens the way to help. 3: Items expire and needs change; the bag needs a set recheck date.

check.prompt_fil: Kumpirmado na ang kasalukuyang lead. Ano ang ligtas na susunod na hakbang?
check.prompt_en: You have confirmed the current lead. What is the safe next step?

options.fil: Gamitin ang lumang roster at ipalagay ang dating mandato.
options.en: Use an old roster and assume its former mandate.

options.fil: Iulat ang lugar, pangangailangan at ginawa; itala ang oras.
options.en: Report location, need and action taken; record the time.

options.fil: Mag-handover nang hindi inaalam kung natanggap ito ng team.
options.en: Hand over without checking that the lead or team received it.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Maaaring makapinsala o maantala ang tulong: hindi lumang roster ang batayan ng team ngayon. 2: Sa maikling handover na may oras, masusundan ang pangangailangan. 3: Kung walang pagtanggap, walang nakaaalam kung natanggap ang pangangailangan.
check.feedback_en: 1: This may harm or delay help: an old roster does not set today's team. 2: A short handover with the time recorded keeps the need traceable. 3: Without acknowledgement, no one knows the need was received.

check.prompt_fil: Naipangkat mo na ang mga pangangailangan. Ano ang ligtas na susunod na hakbang?
check.prompt_en: You have sorted the needs. What is the safe next step?

options.fil: Tratuhin ang lahat bilang isang medical case at magbigay ng sariling therapy.
options.en: Treat every need as a single medical case and give therapy yourself.

options.fil: Ipasa ang bawat pangangailangan sa focal person at alamin ang feedback.
options.en: Hand each need to its focal person and confirm how feedback returns.

options.fil: Sabihin sa mga pamilya na ayos ang tubig para hindi na sila mag-alala.
options.en: Tell families the water is fine so that they stop worrying.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Maaaring makapinsala o maantala ang tulong: labas sa tungkulin ng BHW ang therapy at pagrereseta. 2: Sa referral na may daan ng feedback, posible ang follow-up. 3: WASH staff lang ang makapagsasabing ligtas ang tubig; iulat sa kanila ang alalahanin.
check.feedback_en: 1: This may harm or delay help: therapy and prescribing are outside the BHW role. 2: Referral with a feedback route makes follow-up possible. 3: Only WASH staff can say the water is safe; report the concern to them.

check.prompt_fil: May lead na ang bawat isyu. Ano ang ligtas na susunod na hakbang?
check.prompt_en: Each issue now has a lead. What is the safe next step?

options.fil: Iwanang walang kapalit ang pagod na responder at walang follow-up ang referral.
options.en: Leave the exhausted responder without relief and the referral without follow-up.

options.fil: Itala ang bawat pagtanggap, magtakda ng follow-up at kapalit ng volunteer.
options.en: Record each acknowledgement, set follow-up and relieve the volunteer.

options.fil: Gamitin ang anumang contact na naaalala mo kahit hindi ito kumpirmado.
options.en: Use any contact you remember, even if it is not confirmed.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Maaaring makapinsala o maantala ang tulong: kailangan ng follow-up ang volunteer at ang referral. 2: Sa naitalang pagtanggap at follow-up, may may-ari ang bawat isyu, kasama ang pag-aalaga sa responder. 3: Kumpirmahin ang lahat ng contact at ruta bago gamitin.
check.feedback_en: 1: This may harm or delay help: the volunteer and the referral both need follow-up. 2: Recorded acknowledgement and follow-up keep every issue owned, including responder care. 3: Verify every contact and route before use.
